$comment: The SINGLE source of the @temporeum/timeline-core entry points. Rollup builds from it (scripts/build-config.mjs), `node ../../scripts/sdk_entries.mjs --write` writes the exports, typesVersions and size-limit fields of package.json from it, and the entries check fails on any drift. A new entry point: one line here, then --write. `name: index` is the package root (`.`); the others are the `./<name>` subpath. The `limit` is minify + gzip of the entry point's FULL surface (import *), shared chunks included. A limit leaves room: at least 10% and at least 750 B over the size when it was set (1.0.1), rounded up to the next half kB, so a fix is not a hunt for bytes; it is raised the same way when the room is used up, never to the byte.
